lines.text: اهنی را ماند برنك ازرق قبیح المنظر و او را دم باشد از طرف پیش و بر طبیعت زحل است و کند
lines.en: It resembles iron, of a blue color, ugly in appearance, and it has a tail from the front side, and it is of the nature of Saturn, and it is slow.

lines.text: کوکب کوکبیست اصهب یعنی سرخ رنك و او را دمیست طویل از جانب پیش حاسب مکی کوید که
lines.en: The star is a reddish-brown star, meaning red-colored, and it has a long tail from the front side. The Meccan calculator says that

lines.text: يك صنف دیگر هست که او را ذوالذراعین کویند مثل کوکبیست که او را دو شاخ است از دو طرف
lines.en: there is another kind which they call 'the one with two arms', like a star that has two horns from two sides,

lines.text: مخالف و بر طبیعت راس است اما احمری که مایل بسواد است حاسب مکی کوید که اصفر است
lines.en: opposite [each other], and it is of the nature of the Head [of the Dragon]. But the red one that inclines to blackness, the Meccan calculator says that it is yellow

lines.text: مایل بسواد و مع هذا قسم سوم اسنا بسود ولون او مثل لون دود است و شعاع او مستدیر
lines.en: inclining to blackness. And with this, the third kind is black, and its color is like the color of smoke, and its ray is round.

lines.text: الشکل کندی او را ذوالید خوانده و گفته که کوکبیست ذو غصن و یکطرف او در شعاع است
lines.en: Al-Kindi called it 'the one with the hand' and said that it is a star with a branch, and one side of it is in the ray,

lines.text: و بر هر تقدیر مزاج زحل است (مقصد چهارم در تاثیرات کواکب ذوات الذوائب) اکثر
lines.en: and in any case, it is of the nature of Saturn. (The fourth destination: on the effects of the stars with tails). Most

lines.text: اکثر اکابر این فن بر این اند که هر کدام از ذوات الاذناب بر مزاج کوکب نحسند از سیارات تاثیر
lines.en: of the great ones of this art are of the opinion that whichever of the ones with tails is of the nature of an inauspicious star from the planets, its effect

lines.text: ردی دهند و هر کدام بر مزاج کوکب سعد اند ردی الاثر نباشند بلکه سعادت دهند چنانکه
lines.en: is bad, and whichever is of the nature of an auspicious star, its effect is not bad, but rather they give auspiciousness, as

lines.text: معلم اول ارسطاطالیس در صد فصل اسکندری فرموده که الکواکب التی یسمی ذوات الذوائب
lines.en: the First Teacher, Aristotle, in the Hundred Chapters of Alexander, has stated that the stars which are called 'the ones with tails'

lines.text: سبع علی مثال الکواکب السبعة منها خمسة المتحیره واثنان شبهان بمزاج النیرین وبالجملة
lines.en: are seven, on the example of the seven planets, of which five are the wandering ones, and two resemble the nature of the two luminaries. And in general,

lines.text: یدل علی تغیرات واحوال تظهر فی العالم وتشهر الا ما کان منها شبیها بمزاج السعود یدل علی
lines.en: they indicate changes and conditions that appear in the world and become famous, except for what among them is similar to the nature of the auspicious ones, which indicates

lines.text: تغیرات الی الصلاح والخیر وما کان شبهها بمزاج النحوس یدل علی تغیرات الی الفساد والشر
lines.en: changes towards goodness and benefit, and what among them is similar to the nature of the inauspicious ones indicates changes towards corruption and evil.

lines.text: وصاحب کفایة التعلیم کوید که بیشتر برانند که ان دو ستاره که منسوبند بمشتری و زهره دلیل
lines.en: And the author of Kifāyat al-Taʿlīm says that most are of the opinion that those two stars which are attributed to Jupiter and Venus are an indication

lines.text: خصب و خیراند و مرا استوار نمیاید مکر انکه روشن تر بود سر انکه بزرگتر باشد برای انکه هر چه
lines.en: of fertility and good, and it does not seem reliable to me unless it is brighter, the head of which is larger, because whatever

lines.text: من دیدم همه دلیل شر و قحط و مرك بزرکان بود چنانکه در اخر عهد سلطان رضوان دیدم در جانب
lines.en: I have seen was all an indication of evil and famine and the death of great ones, as I saw at the end of the era of Sultan Ridwan in the direction of

lines.text: مغرب و در وقت سفر غور از جانب مشرق و ان سیار بود و از افتاب در کذشت و در جانب
lines.en: the west, and at the time of the journey to Ghur from the direction of the east, and it was a planet, and it passed the sun, and in the direction of

lines.text: مغرب رو داد هرم و دلیل شر بودند و چکونه نباشند که ماده همه بخار و دخانی است
lines.en: the west it showed its face, and they were an indication of evil. And how could they not be, since the matter of all of them is vapor and smoke

lines.text: که مشتعل میکردد و بخار دخانی سبب غلبه خشم است بر طبعها و استیلای امراض بر مزاجها
lines.en: that ignites, and smoky vapor is the cause of the dominance of anger over natures and the prevalence of diseases over temperaments,

lines.text: و نقصان ابها در کاریزها و چشمهها و غلبه خشم سبب حربست و استیلای امراض سبب مرك و
lines.en: and the decrease of waters in qanats and springs. And the dominance of anger is the cause of war, and the overcoming of diseases is the cause of death, and

lines.text: نقصان اب سبب قحط انتهی و اکثری از متاخرین در این استدلال بر عقیده صاحب کفایه اند
lines.en: the decrease of water is the cause of famine. End quote. And most of the later scholars in this reasoning are of the opinion of the author of Kifayah.

lines.text: اما صاحب اشجار الاثمار غلبه خشم بر طبایع را از استیلای مریخ که سبب ظهور این علامات
lines.en: But the author of Ashjar al-Athmar considers the dominance of anger over natures to be from the prevalence of Mars, which is the cause of the appearance of these signs,

lines.text: شده است میداند و این سخن خالی از قوتی نیست (احکام ذوذوابه و ذوذنب) ذوذوابه
lines.en: and this statement is not devoid of strength. (Judgments of the one with a forelock and the one with a tail). The one with a forelock

sections.en: On the effects of the ones with tails
and the one with a tail

summary.headline: Effects of Tailed Stars
summary.text: Descriptions of several tailed-star forms—blue and Saturnine, reddish with a long tail, two-armed, and black with a smoky ray—followed by judgments on their effects. Aristotle, al-Kindi, the Meccan calculator, the authors of Kifāyat al-Taʿlīm and Ashjār al-Athmār, and Sultan Ridwan are cited in connection with omens of prosperity, corruption, war, disease, famine, and the deaths of great people.
